destination.title: De Sitter compactifications: existence, stability and control
destination.question: Under which source-specific ingredients, geometries and approximation regimes can de Sitter compactifications exist, remain stable and admit a controlled description?
destination.summary: Classical type-II constructions form the main concentration. Source matching, quantum corrections, evolving internal configurations and other external dimensions supply distinct questions within a broader family. Numerical proximity establishes neither equivalence nor a controlled vacuum.

systems: Type IIA and type IIB compactifications
M-theory descriptions related to type IIB
IIA Calabi-Yau universal sectors with gravitino condensates
targets: Existence and exclusion of de Sitter solutions
Source localization, boundary conditions and noncompact curvature
Scalar stability, probe-brane instability and decompactification dynamics
String consistency, correction control, quantization and scale separation
Quantum-corrected effective descriptions and conditional slope bounds
regimes: Classical or tree-level analyses where explicitly stated
Four-dimensional examples, three-dimensional examples, D>4 tests and dimension-dependent surveys
Static and evolving internal configurations, kept distinct
assumptions: Each source retains its own ansatz and source restrictions
Existence, stability and control are separate tests
Reported conjectures and construction claims are not established family-wide premises
conventions: Respect source-specific curvature signs, frames and coupling definitions
External de Sitter geometry does not establish invariance of every evolving field
includes: Necessary-condition analyses and unsuccessful construction tests
excludes: Treating Festina Lente bounds as a compactification-existence question
Treating strong-CP relaxation as a de Sitter-existence question
Automatic equivalence of sources addressing the same overview

sources.title: Simple de Sitter Solutions

evidence.text: Can negative internal curvature, fluxes, orientifolds, fractional Chern-Simons terms, and wrapped fivebranes produce simple metastable de Sitter minima in type IIA with controllable corrections and separated physical scales?

sources.title: Minimal simple de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: What minimal tree-level ingredients permit metastable four-dimensional de Sitter solutions in massive IIA, and when do additional geometric moduli obstruct stabilization?

sources.title: Towards Classical de Sitter Solutions in String Theory

evidence.text: Which classical ingredients and internal-geometric conditions are necessary for type II de Sitter solutions, and can a simple SU(3)-structure O6 ansatz satisfy the complete ten-dimensional equations?

sources.title: On Classical de Sitter Vacua in String Theory

evidence.text: Which minimal classical ingredients evade simple no-go theorems against de Sitter extrema and slow-roll inflation, and what further obstructions appear in selected geometric compactifications with four-dimensional N=1 descriptions?

sources.title: De Sitter hunting in a classical landscape

evidence.text: Which homogeneous SU(3)-structure orientifolds admit classical de Sitter critical points, and can these satisfy perturbative stability, flux/charge quantization and localization requirements?

sources.title: On Brane Back-Reaction and de Sitter Solutions in Higher-Dimensional Supergravity

evidence.text: Which properties of localized sources and back-reacted bulk fields determine the curvature of maximally symmetric noncompact dimensions, and how do these affect classical de Sitter no-go arguments?

sources.title: Scaling limits of dS vacua and the swampland

evidence.text: Can classical massive type IIA de Sitter solutions have both large internal volume and weak string coupling, suppressing α′ and string-loop corrections? The paper also asks whether this suppression can become arbitrarily good along a family of solutions.

sources.title: Scaling limits of dS vacua and the swampland

evidence.text: The STU example tests the general scaling argument with an explicit potential and examines whether anti-D6-supported de Sitter critical points can become trustworthy. Restoring non-isotropic directions tests whether apparent stability survives beyond the six-field truncation.

sources.title: Constraints and horizons for de Sitter with extra dimensions

evidence.text: What local geometric conditions permit four-dimensional de Sitter expansion with static extra dimensions, and what null-congruence horizons or antitrapped regions accompany such geometries?

sources.title: New de Sitter solutions of 10d type IIB supergravity

evidence.text: Can intersecting O5/D5 configurations on six-dimensional group manifolds yield new type-IIB de Sitter solutions, and do those solutions satisfy stability and classical-string consistency requirements?

sources.title: Charting the landscape of (anti-) de Sitter and Minkowski solutions of 10d supergravities

evidence.text: Which maximally symmetric 4d solutions are allowed by the specified type-II supergravity ansatz with orientifolds, which unexplored classes admit numerical examples, and what obstructions constrain de Sitter existence and effective supersymmetry?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does a simple curved massive-IIA compactification with anti-D6-branes admit stable de Sitter extrema, and can its scaling freedom move them to large volume and weak coupling?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can classical de Sitter extrema be considered without the particular conceptual difficulties of Romans-mass compactifications? The reviewed formal IIA/IIB duality motivates examining F1 flux on SU(2)-structure spaces with O5/O7 sources.

sources.title: Metastable vacua from torsion and machine learning

evidence.text: Which ingredients permit a classical metastable de Sitter minimum in a type IIB compactification, and which neglected effects could destabilize it? The search also seeks geometric settings capable of realizing the required effective-potential terms.

sources.title: (Quasi-) de Sitter solutions across dimensions and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Which classical string compactifications admit de Sitter or small-slope quasi-de Sitter solutions for 3≤d≤10, and how do dimension-dependent slope bounds obtained from no-go theorems compare with the TCC bound?

sources.title: Simple de Sitter Solutions

evidence.text: Organize U through a,b,c and minimize δ = 4ac/b²−1 over other moduli. Near a nondegenerate minimum with small positive δ, estimate tadpoles, quadratic terms, and O(δ) shifts to obtain a nearby positive-energy stationary minimum.

sources.title: Minimal simple de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Dimensionally reduce the tree-level massive IIA action and source terms to four-dimensional Einstein frame, retaining numerical factors, flux quantization and integrated tadpole constraints.

sources.title: Towards Classical de Sitter Solutions in String Theory

evidence.text: Derives universal scalings VR=URρ^-1τ^-2, VH=UHρ^-3τ^-2 and Vq=Uqρ^(3−q)τ^-4. For V=aτ^-2−bτ^-3+cτ^-4, uses stationary 4ac/b²≈1 as a diagnostic for small positive vacuum energy.

sources.title: On Classical de Sitter Vacua in String Theory

evidence.text: Use universal Einstein-frame scalings VH∼τ^−2ρ^−3, VFp∼τ^−4ρ^(3−p), VOq∼τ^−3ρ^((q−6)/2), and VR6∼τ^−2ρ^−1. Flux contributions are nonnegative, orientifold contributions nonpositive, and the curvature contribution has either sign.

sources.title: De Sitter hunting in a classical landscape

evidence.text: Analyze RR quantization with integer H-twisted homology, using ∂H=∂+H∩ and a spectral-sequence calculation. H periods are quantized separately; the Bianchi identity relates Romans mass and source charge.

sources.title: On Brane Back-Reaction and de Sitter Solutions in Higher-Dimensional Supergravity

evidence.text: Contract the noncompact Einstein equations and integrate over the higher-dimensional geometry, separating the on-shell bulk action, warp-factor divergence, localized source variation, and explicit noncompact metric dependence of matter.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: This ansatz isolates whether an exactly de Sitter external metric can coexist with a static compactification and controlled corrections. Its uplift translates late conformal time into a small type IIA coupling.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Must every classical de Sitter solution with intersecting Op/Dp sources contain a scalar direction of negative mass squared?

sources.title: Higher codimension de Sitter branes

evidence.text: Can genuine higher-codimension branes support de Sitter curvature in a compact internal space when bulk stress satisfies the Maldacena-Nuñez sign condition, and what changes when sources retain finite thickness?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification geometry, fluxes and quantum corrections support four-dimensional de Sitter isometries with constant Newton coupling and a controlled effective field theory, despite obstructions found for time-independent internal configurations?

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Can a classical de Sitter supergravity solution satisfy weak coupling, large physical lengths, flux quantization, and bounded orientifold availability simultaneously?

sources.title: Intricacies of classical de Sitter string backgrounds

evidence.text: Can two explicit ten-dimensional supergravity de Sitter solutions be promoted to classical string backgrounds after imposing coupling, size, flux, source-count, and lattice requirements, and how do these restrictions interact with scale separation?

sources.title: New constraints on classical de Sitter: flirting with the swampland

evidence.text: Can classical type II compactifications with parallel orientifold and D-brane sources support de Sitter spacetime? If solutions exist, do volume, dilaton, and source-adapted anisotropy fluctuations necessarily contain a tachyon?

sources.title: On classical de Sitter and Minkowski solutions with intersecting branes

evidence.text: Which classical type II compactifications with intersecting Dp-branes and Op-planes permit four-dimensional de Sitter or Minkowski solutions, and how does source overlap constrain their existence?

sources.title: Classical de Sitter solutions in three dimensions without tachyons?

evidence.text: Can mixed O2/anti-D2 and O6/anti-D6 sources evade the usual universal instability without requiring a negatively curved internal manifold?

sources.title: Scaling limits of dS vacua and the swampland

evidence.text: Do suitable orientifold geometries admit large O6-plane counts, and do any realize de Sitter extrema at large volume and weak coupling? The formal source-count scaling motivates this question without resolving geometric existence or the size of a possible upper bound.

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Can the de Sitter coefficient c be derived from low-energy effective-theory data, and can membrane extremality determine it? The source distinguishes this unresolved goal from geometric evidence available in particular compactifications.

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quantum-corrected flux compactifications support four-dimensional de Sitter geometry while retaining a controlled supergravity description? The supplied analysis studies this through an M-theory background related to type IIB by dimensional reduction and T-duality.

sources.title: Universal de Sitter solutions at tree-level

evidence.text: Can classical four-dimensional de Sitter solutions of type IIA compactification be constructed directly in ten dimensions using only universal SU(3)-structure forms and torsion classes, and can an explicit geometry satisfy the resulting conditions?

sources.title: Towards an explicit construction of de Sitter solutions in classical supergravity

evidence.text: Can a proposed massive-IIA de Sitter construction with O8± sources be described semi-analytically by expanding in four-dimensional curvature, and what does this reveal about disputed orientifold boundary conditions and the four-dimensional gravitational coupling?

sources.title: On classical de Sitter solutions and parametric control

evidence.text: Can specific type IIB de Sitter compactifications satisfy flux, source and lattice quantization together with classical string control, and can a scaling improve control parametrically or evade proposed asymptotic de Sitter obstructions?

sources.title: Classical de Sitter solutions in three dimensions without tachyons?

evidence.text: Can a classical massive IIA compactification stabilize its retained moduli in three-dimensional de Sitter space while also controlling supersymmetry breaking, localized sources, and anti-brane decay?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Which restrictions on classical compactifications make de Sitter exclusion possible? The setting separates the two-derivative positive-tension regime from constructions containing orientifolds, curvature, or string-scale corrections.

sources.title: New constraints on classical de Sitter: flirting with the swampland

evidence.text: The setting isolates classical de Sitter compactifications with a common source-adapted split of six internal dimensions. This split permits a scalar that changes parallel and transverse lengths differently.

sources.title: Classical de Sitter Solutions of 10-Dimensional Supergravity

evidence.text: Can massive type IIA supergravity admit four-dimensional de Sitter compactifications obtained directly from the full ten-dimensional equations with localized, backreacted orientifolds, and how far can weak coupling and small curvature justify their classical description?

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in the String Landscape: La Petite Version

evidence.text: Can a type IIB compactification with an external de Sitter metric retain an effective description when its internal warp factors and fluxes evolve, while the axion, type IIB dilaton and four-dimensional Newton constant remain fixed?

sources.title: Tachyonic de Sitter Solutions of 10d Type II Supergravities

evidence.text: Must a classical geometric type II de Sitter solution be unstable, and can its instability always be detected through the overall volume, four-dimensional dilaton, and source-wrapped volumes?

sources.title: Spontaneous decompactification

evidence.text: How does a metastable four-dimensional de Sitter compactification escape toward decompactification, what governs its subsequent higher-dimensional expansion, and could reverse transitions provide a compactification mechanism?

sources.title: Oh, wait, O8 de Sitter may be unstable!

evidence.text: Does probe D8-brane dynamics reveal an instability of the CDLT1 de Sitter compactifications, and can the positive-charge orientifold source be identified sufficiently precisely to interpret that instability in string theory?

sources.title: On classical de Sitter solutions in higher dimensions

evidence.text: Which classical type-II orientifold compactifications to D>4 can satisfy necessary existence and perturbative-stability conditions for de Sitter vacua, as tested by the universal volume and dilaton directions?

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Can classical type II supergravity with Op/Dp sources support four-dimensional de Sitter spacetime? The paper fixes a commonly used smeared compactification ansatz to formulate existence, stability, and string-control questions.

sources.title: Tachyonic de Sitter Solutions of 10d Type II Supergravities

evidence.text: Which scalar instabilities occur in geometric type IIB de Sitter backgrounds supported by curvature, fluxes, and intersecting O5/D5 sources?

sources.title: Refining the boundaries of the classical de Sitter landscape

evidence.text: Which classical de Sitter solutions can exist in ten-dimensional type II supergravity with spacetime-filling Dp/Op sources of one fixed dimension, principally with parallel sources? The target is existence, without a four-dimensional stability analysis.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Can classical type II compactifications admit de Sitter solutions within a regime of weak string coupling and large internal volume, and can their instability be established within the restricted source ansatz?

sources.title: No classical (anti-)de Sitter solutions with O8-planes

evidence.text: Can classical Type IIA compactifications with only O8-planes/D8-branes support de Sitter space, and can singular source behavior justify the boundary conditions used in proposed numerical de Sitter and Romans-mass-only anti-de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: How do intersecting source sets change the existence restrictions derived for parallel sources?

sources.title: Consistent truncation and de Sitter space from gravitational instantons

evidence.text: Can ALE gravitational-instanton gravitino condensates be incorporated into a consistent universal-sector truncation of IIA Calabi-Yau compactification, and can the resulting theory admit de Sitter solutions in a controlled regime?

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Does the restricted classical type II compactification problem admit a de Sitter solution when every Op/Dp source is parallel?

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking branes on solvmanifolds and de Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Can classical geometric type IIA compactifications with sources breaking bulk supersymmetry yield ten-dimensional de Sitter solutions, and can generalized first-order equations simplify their construction?

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB String Theory: Classical Solutions and Quantum Corrections

evidence.text: Can ten-dimensional type IIB compactifications with fluxes and localized sources yield four-dimensional de Sitter geometry, and what conditions must quantum curvature corrections satisfy to evade classical obstructions?

destination.title: IIB moduli stabilization, consistency and phenomenology
destination.question: What stabilization mechanisms, consistency conditions and phenomenological possibilities arise in the supplied IIB compactification settings, and how do adjacent flux-stabilization and conifold-dynamics questions compare?
destination.summary: A broad navigation family containing distinct constructions and applications. Stabilization, de Sitter viability, global consistency and phenomenological control remain separate tests whose outcomes depend on the source's geometry, regime and assumptions.

systems: Type IIB compactifications, including Calabi–Yau orientifolds and co-calibrated G2 orientifolds
Type IIB/F-theory settings for complex-structure dynamics
Adjacent IIA and M-theory SU(3)-structure compactifications as comparison material
targets: Moduli stabilization, vacuum structure and supersymmetry breaking
Global brane consistency and chiral visible sectors
Inflation, reheating, early dark energy and late-time acceleration
QCD axions, ALPs, physical scales and convention translation
Three-dimensional superpotentials, scale separation and conifold-transition dynamics
regimes: Large-volume and moderately large-radius regimes where specified
Three-dimensional N=1 and supplied four-dimensional effective theories
AdS, nearly Minkowski and candidate de Sitter settings
Distinct inflationary, early-dark-energy and late-time cosmological phases
assumptions: Each construction retains its own stabilization and control conditions.
An announced target or reported example does not establish universal existence, stability or phenomenological viability.
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work remains eligible.
conventions: Frame, length-unit and 2π choices require explicit translation where physical scales are compared.
includes: Description-only questions with visibly limited evidence
A mixed-theory comparison home without assigning its IIA/M-theory results to IIB
excludes: A common requirement of four dimensions, de Sitter vacua or one stabilization mechanism
Canonical identity inferred from numerical membership
Historical assertions promoted to universal premises

sources.title: The type IIB string axiverse and its low-energy phenomenology

evidence.text: Can type IIB LARGE Volume Scenario compactifications retain an uneaten QCD axion and additional ultralight ALPs after moduli stabilisation, and what couplings, cosmology and observational opportunities follow?

sources.title: Three-dimensional flux vacua from IIB on co-calibrated G2 orientifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIB compactifications on co-calibrated G2 orientifolds yield a 3D N=1 superpotential, complete closed-string moduli stabilization, classical de Sitter extrema, and parametric scale separation consistent with string constraints?

sources.title: The Standard Model quiver in de Sitter string compactifications

evidence.text: Can an orientifolded D3-brane Standard Model quiver be embedded in a compact type IIB Calabi–Yau with consistent brane charges, moduli stabilisation, supersymmetry breaking and a controlled de Sitter minimum?

sources.title: A guide to frames, 2π’s, scales and corrections in string compactifications

evidence.text: How should common string/Einstein frame, length-unit and 2π conventions be translated consistently in type IIB compactifications when comparing physical scales and corrections relevant to moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Moduli stabilisation for ADD and the Dark Dimension scenario

evidence.text: Can type IIB moduli stabilisation produce one or two large extra dimensions, together with late-time acceleration and acceptable particle-physics and cosmological phenomenology?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation and Applications in IIB String Theory

evidence.text: How can IIB compactification moduli be stabilised with controlled corrections, and how can the resulting potentials support supersymmetry breaking, QCD axions and inflation?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Cosmology of Type IIB on SU(2)-Structure Orientifolds

evidence.text: Can classical type IIB compactifications with O5/O7-planes generate potentials for all geometric moduli, stabilize them in controlled vacua, and admit metastable de Sitter vacua or slow-roll inflation?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Cosmology of Type IIB on SU(2)-Structure Orientifolds

evidence.text: Exploit factorization of Kähler and complex-structure sectors to construct directional derivative inequalities for V. Positive semidefinite contributions to the potential-gradient norm can be discarded to obtain lower bounds on ε.

sources.title: The type IIB string axiverse and its low-energy phenomenology

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction of RR fields and D-brane Chern–Simons terms determines axionic kinetic terms, gauge couplings and flux-induced Stückelberg charges.

sources.title: Three-dimensional flux vacua from IIB on co-calibrated G2 orientifolds

evidence.text: Vacua are studied through superpotential stationarity, scalar-potential critical equations, numerical mass/Hessian examples, and large-parameter scaling of flux and curvature contributions. A real nilpotent scalar superfield X, X²=0, encodes the BSB contribution.

sources.title: The Standard Model quiver in de Sitter string compactifications

evidence.text: Use protected B-model data, exceptional collections, Ext groups and Riemann–Roch Euler pairings to determine chirality. Construct fractional-brane bound states through bifundamental VEVs, analyse gauge breaking and distinguish three chiral families from vector-like matter.

sources.title: A guide to frames, 2π’s, scales and corrections in string compactifications

evidence.text: Expand higher-dimensional fields in warped-Laplacian eigenmodes to obtain KK masses; match the flux scalar potential to N=1 supergravity to normalize W; expand the D-brane DBI action to identify gauge couplings controlling gaugino condensation.

sources.title: Moduli stabilisation for ADD and the Dark Dimension scenario

evidence.text: Hierarchical supergravity-potential minimisation: α′³ corrections to K and del Pezzo non-perturbative terms fix the overall volume; canonical normalisation identifies the remaining saxionic direction; winding-string loops and higher-derivative F⁴ terms subsequently lift it.

sources.title: Issues in Complex Structure Moduli Inflation

evidence.text: Can complex-structure moduli participate in slow-roll inflation or reheating in moderately large-radius Type IIB/F-theory compactifications while preserving volume stabilization, particularly in a right-handed-sneutrino scenario?

sources.title: Early Dark Energy in Type IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Can type IIB compactifications realize V=V0[1−cos(ϕ/f)]³ with phenomenological EDE parameters, controlled dS moduli stabilization, decoupled non-EDE modes and little microscopic tuning? A globally consistent Calabi–Yau embedding is a further stated goal.

sources.title: Physical Vacua in IIB Compactifications with a Single Kaehler Modulus

evidence.text: Can type IIB Calabi–Yau orientifold compactifications with one Kähler modulus produce nearly Minkowski or de Sitter vacua with spontaneous SUSY breaking and TeV-scale superpartners, while avoiding the additional flavor constraints motivating the single-modulus restriction?

sources.title: Fibre Inflation: Observable Gravity Waves from IIB String Compactifications

evidence.text: Can stabilized type-IIB compactifications support trans-Planckian slow-roll motion and potentially observable primordial tensors, with predictions insensitive to most potential parameters and calculational control from the large-volume expansion?

sources.title: Global Orientifolded Quivers with Inflation

evidence.text: Can an orientifolded chiral quiver at a singularity be embedded in a compact type-IIB model satisfying global brane constraints, with stabilized closed-string moduli, a tunable Minkowski/de Sitter vacuum and viable inflation in the same geometry?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation and the Holographic Swampland

evidence.text: How do particle masses and couplings vary with the overall volume of a large-volume IIB compactification? The canonical field grows logarithmically with volume, so a Planck-scale displacement produces a multiplicative volume change.

sources.title: Aspects of moduli stabilisation in string and M-theory

evidence.text: Can flux compactifications stabilise geometric moduli, and can type IIB conifold transitions dynamically complete rather than trap moduli? The thesis studies the resulting four-dimensional effective theories and their cosmological dynamics.

sources.title: Seeking de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Review how type IIB Calabi–Yau orientifolds can stabilise moduli and realise de Sitter vacua, particularly through purely perturbative corrections, and which geometric requirements permit a concrete global embedding.

sources.title: Systematics of moduli stabilisation in Calabi-Yau flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can leading α′ corrections combined with nonperturbative effects stabilize type IIB compactifications at exponentially large volume without a hierarchically small flux superpotential, and yield stable nonsupersymmetric AdS or uplifted de Sitter vacua? How do the gravitino and string scales depend on flux choices?

sources.title: D-Branes at del Pezzo Singularities: Global Embedding and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Can phenomenologically interesting fractional-D3 quivers at del Pezzo singularities be embedded in compact type IIB orientifolds while satisfying global consistency conditions and stabilising the Kähler moduli?

destinations.title: Can classical type IIB compactifications with O5/O7-planes generate potentials for all geometric moduli, stabilize them in controlled vacua, and admit metastable de Sitter vacua or slow-roll inflation?

Can type IIB LARGE Volume Scenario compactifications retain an uneaten QCD axion and additional ultralight ALPs after moduli stabilisation, and what couplings, cosmology and observational opportunities follow?

Can type IIB compactifications on co-calibrated G2 orientifolds yield a 3D N=1 superpotential, complete closed-string moduli stabilization, classical de Sitter extrema, and parametric scale separation consistent with string constraints?

Can an orientifolded D3-brane Standard Model quiver be embedded in a compact type IIB Calabi–Yau with consistent brane charges, moduli stabilisation, supersymmetry breaking and a controlled de Sitter minimum?

How should common string/Einstein frame, length-unit and 2π conventions be translated consistently in type IIB compactifications when comparing physical scales and corrections relevant to moduli stabilization?
Can type IIB moduli stabilisation produce one or two large extra dimensions, together with late-time acceleration and acceptable particle-physics and cosmological phenomenology?
How can IIB compactification moduli be stabilised with controlled corrections, and how can the resulting potentials support supersymmetry breaking, QCD axions and inflation?

destination.title: Supersymmetric matter and gravity: constructions and consistency
destination.question: How are supersymmetric matter and gravity theories constructed, and which current, geometric, interaction and consistency conditions delimit their use?
destination.summary: No original scientific scope statement accompanies the numerical membership proposal. Its useful core connects supercurrents, FI couplings, constrained multiplets, component actions, brane interactions and scalar geometry. Quantum-gravity and cosmological tests provide further directions; localization surveys, fermion unification, two-dimensional phase correspondence and spacetime-solution classification require separate access.

systems: Supersymmetric field theories and supergravity, with dimensions and supersymmetry specified separately by source
Matter-coupled, constrained-superfield, brane and DBI/Born–Infeld systems
targets: Component actions, nonlinear supersymmetry and EFT validity
regimes: Classical constructions, quantum anomalies and conditional completion criteria
assumptions: Numerical membership is candidate provenance, not a scientific premise
Different dimensions, systems and methods can belong to this broad family without sharing a fine question
Ordinary and pre-Swampland supergravity work remains eligible
conventions: Distinguish constant, field-dependent and ACIK FI terms
Distinguish scalar target-space geometry from spacetime geometry
Keep controlled rigid limits, formal rigid limits and intrinsically gravitational theories separate
excludes: Universal FI obstructions inferred from restricted historical arguments
Fine equivalence inferred from a shared overview card

sources.title: Comments on the Fayet-Iliopoulos Term in Field Theory and Supergravity

evidence.text: What does the gauge transformation of the supercurrent multiplet imply for genuine constant FI terms, their renormalization and dynamical generation, and their coupling to supergravity and quantum gravity?

sources.title: The Fayet-Iliopoulos term and nonlinear self-duality

evidence.text: Can a Fayet-Iliopoulos deformation preserve the Goldstone-Maxwell interpretation of supersymmetric Born-Infeld theory and partial N=2→N=1 breaking? The paper also asks how FI terms interact with nonlinear self-duality, Goldstino actions and supercurrent constructions.

sources.title: Matter-coupled de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: How can one construct matter-coupled N=1 supergravity with one nilpotent chiral multiplet, eliminate its non-Gaussian auxiliary field, and obtain a manageable fermionic action and positive vacuum-energy contribution?

sources.title: The general de Sitter supergravity component action

evidence.text: What is the full component action, including fermions, for one nilpotent chiral multiplet coupled to 4d N = 1 supergravity and arbitrary chiral/vector matter, when linear nilpotent-field terms in the Kähler potential are allowed?

sources.title: Constrained superfields in Supergravity

evidence.text: Do established globally supersymmetric superfield constraints admit consistent supergravity solutions, what component actions result, and can a new constraint remove a chiral fermion while retaining its scalar and auxiliary field?

sources.title: Supergravitational Conformal Galileons

evidence.text: How can conformal Galileon worldvolume actions of an AdS5 probe three-brane be extended to flat N = 1 supersymmetry and then N = 1 supergravity, while treating scalar stability and derivative interactions of the nominal auxiliary field F?

sources.title: Gaugino Condensation and Geometry of the Perfect Square

evidence.text: Why must a supersymmetric non-Abelian Dp-brane description contain a nonderivative four-gaugino interaction, and how does superspace geometry explain its perfect-square organization with the three-form relevant to gaugino condensation?

sources.title: Special Geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which integral special Kähler scalar geometries admit quantum-gravity UV completions in ungauged four-dimensional N = 2 vector sectors?

sources.title: Swampland geometry and the gauge couplings

evidence.text: Which intrinsic geometric conditions on scalar metrics and gauge-coupling maps are necessary for quantum-gravity completion, and can the domestic geometry unifying supersymmetric examples extend approximately or exactly to non-supersymmetric theories?

sources.title: 4D effective action from the non-Abelian DBI action with a magnetic flux background

evidence.text: What flux-dependent matter Kähler metrics, gauge kinetic functions and holomorphic superpotential follow from dimensional reduction of the bosonic ten-dimensional non-Abelian DBI action through O(F⁴), and are the selected scalar interactions compatible with four-dimensional N=1 supergravity?

sources.title: Component actions of liberated $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 supergravity and new Fayet-Iliopoulos terms in superconformal tensor calculus

evidence.text: How can superconformal tensor calculus expose the component interactions of liberated N=1 supergravity and the Kähler-invariant ACIK Fayet–Iliopoulos term, and how do singular fermionic operators constrain their effective-field-theory cutoff and couplings?

sources.title: Superconformal symmetry, supergravity and cosmology

evidence.text: How does a fully superconformal formulation organize N=1 matter-coupled supergravity, FI terms and the cosmological super-Higgs effect, and explain longitudinal gravitino production that survives weak gravitational coupling?

sources.title: Superspace Or One Thousand and One Lessons in Supersymmetry

evidence.text: How does superspace provide manifestly supersymmetric representations, actions, component projections, and quantization methods for global supersymmetry and supergravity, chiefly with N=1 supersymmetry?

sources.title: Superfield Noether procedure

evidence.text: Can a manifestly supersymmetric Noether procedure directly construct supercurrents, their improvement terms and central charges for general local effective actions, while also organizing linearized supergravity couplings?

sources.title: Fayet-Iliopoulos terms in supergravity and cosmology

evidence.text: What restrictions does local supersymmetry impose on constant and field-dependent Fayet–Iliopoulos terms, and how do those restrictions affect D-term inflation, cosmic-string modes, and proposed D-brane descriptions?

sources.title: Dirac action on M5 and M2 branes with bulk fluxes

evidence.text: What is the explicit quadratic fermion action for M5 and M2 branes in generic on-shell eleven-dimensional supergravity flux backgrounds, including the M5 chiral two-form, and how might it inform instanton superpotential conditions?

sources.title: Dirac actions for D-branes on backgrounds with fluxes

evidence.text: Can the quadratic Dp-brane fermionic action with background fluxes and nonzero worldvolume field strength be written in a simple Dirac-like form, and can its kinetic operator be made canonical?

sources.title: Superfield integrals in high dimensions

evidence.text: How can high-dimensional fermionic integrals be evaluated covariantly and expressed through Lorentz singlets, making superspace expressions usable for supergravity components and vertex-operator correlators?

sources.title: Comments on the Fayet-Iliopoulos Term in Field Theory and Supergravity

evidence.text: For the full supergravity theory, expand Lξ and its linear gauge transformation δξ in ξ at fixed MP, retaining arbitrary derivative order. Commutativity of the zeroth- and first-order transformations is used to infer an additional exact symmetry order by order.

sources.title: The Fayet-Iliopoulos term and nonlinear self-duality

evidence.text: Construct supercurrents by coupling to an off-shell supergravity formulation, varying with respect to the gravitational prepotential and taking the flat-superspace limit. Compare old-minimal and new-minimal compensators and their different conservation equations.

sources.title: Matter-coupled de Sitter Supergravity

evidence.text: Reduce the problem to a universal partially off-shell action with auxiliary field F, scalar composite X=Ω²/(2F), and symbolic coefficients FG0,A,B,C. Apply the non-Gaussian elimination procedure previously used for pure de Sitter supergravity; alternatively identify these entries directly in a partially off-shell Poincaré-supergravity action.

sources.title: The general de Sitter supergravity component action

evidence.text: Start from a supergravity action off shell only in the chiral auxiliary fields. Integrate out spectator Fi first, leaving F1 with coefficient g1bar1 − g1barj(gbarji)−1gibar1, the relevant Schur complement of the Kähler metric.

sources.title: Constrained superfields in Supergravity

evidence.text: Constraints containing the unknown fermion and its derivatives on both sides are inverted iteratively. Goldstino nilpotency terminates the substitutions; the new fermion-only constraint is also expressed through a composite vector field and a chiral field-strength constraint.

sources.title: Supergravitational Conformal Galileons

evidence.text: Review the geometric brane construction using induced metric, extrinsic curvature and intrinsic curvature. Restrict to the five geometric Lagrangians giving second-order π equations, then reorganize the AdS DBI terms by derivative order, using integration by parts.

sources.title: Variant supercurrent multiplets

evidence.text: Which additional N=1 supercurrent conservation laws follow from classified linearized off-shell supergravity models, and under what improvement and global-definition conditions can they be related to standard multiplets?

sources.title: Linear and nonlinear supersymmetry in field and string theory

evidence.text: Which constrained-superfield theories define consistent nonlinear-supersymmetry EFTs, how should cosmological gravitino production be characterized, and what restrictions govern massive spin-2 gravitational couplings and twisted orientifold constructions?

sources.title: Quantization of Fayet-Iliopoulos Parameters in Supergravity

evidence.text: What geometrically enforces Fayet–Iliopoulos quantization in four-dimensional N=1 supergravity beyond linearly realized scalar actions, and how does this relate to geometric invariant theory?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: How does extended supersymmetry connect scalar geometry, vector kinetic terms, and gravitino couplings? Special Kähler sections and quaternionic moment maps provide the common geometric inputs.

sources.title: The stranger things of symmetric product orbifold CFTs

evidence.text: Does the existence of an exactly marginal single-trace twisted deformation indicate that a symmetric product orbifold can reach a sparse supergravity regime? The paper tests this expectation against protected elliptic-genus growth and perturbative lifting of currents.

sources.title: Comments on Supercurrent Multiplets, Supersymmetric Field Theories and Supergravity

evidence.text: Which supercurrent multiplets are well-defined in supersymmetric theories, what restrictions follow for infrared dynamics, and how can theories lacking both an FZ multiplet and an R symmetry be consistently coupled to supergravity?

sources.title: Variant supercurrents and Noether procedure

evidence.text: Clarify the relationship between the general supercurrent obtained from linearized off-shell supergravity and earlier superfield Noether constructions, and determine which multiplet the Noether procedure naturally produces for a general N=1 nonlinear sigma-model.

sources.title: Clarifying Some Remaining Questions in the Anomaly Puzzle

evidence.text: Can the Adler-Bardeen R-current and the stress tensor belong to one quantum supercurrent despite their one-loop and multiloop anomalies? The paper also asks how equations of motion and infrared contributions enter proposed resolutions.

sources.title: Higher derivative couplings with multi-tensor multiplets in 6D supergravity, action and anomalies

evidence.text: Construct a proper action for six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity with multiple tensor multiplets and gauge anomalies, and obtain the leading supersymmetric gravitational Green–Schwarz curvature-squared counterterm with matter couplings.

sources.title: Modifying the Sum Over Topological Sectors and Constraints on Supergravity

evidence.text: Can local modifications restrict the sum over topological sectors without adding local degrees of freedom, and how does the resulting configuration space alter FI-term and Kähler-class quantization in four-dimensional N=1 supergravity?

sources.title: Options for gauge groups in five-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which compact global symmetries can be gauged in five-dimensional N=2 supergravity, and what restrictions do local supersymmetry and physical kinetic terms impose on scalar geometry, vector fields and tensor representations?

sources.title: Pseudo-Goldstones from supersymmetric Wilson lines on 5-D orbifolds

evidence.text: Can an even fifth gauge component on a supersymmetric 5D orbifold furnish a light 4D pseudo-Goldstone multiplet whose nonderivative interactions and sensitivity to global-symmetry-violating quantum gravity are suppressed?

sources.title: On extended supersymmetry of 4d Galileons and 3-brane effective actions

evidence.text: Can Galileons appear as higher-derivative corrections to supersymmetric brane dynamics? DBI supplies the leading scalar, fermion and vector interactions and provides additional constructible mixed-order amplitudes that test Galileon candidates.

sources.title: Supersymmetry, Large Extra Dimensions and the Gravitino Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the non-observation of supersymmetry and large extra dimensions be correlated through the Gravitino Conjecture, and how do internal anisotropy and dimensionality constrain that connection?

sources.title: On the Inconsistency of Fayet-Iliopoulos Terms in Supergravity Theories

evidence.text: Does a nonzero Fayet–Iliopoulos term intrinsically obstruct coupling to supergravity, or do apparent inconsistencies depend on the chiral versus linear compensator formalism and its treatment of R-symmetry?

sources.title: Supergravity scattering amplitudes

evidence.text: How can massive scalar three- and four-point amplitudes be calculated geometrically in supergravity with curved field space, and under what background conditions do Riemann normal coordinates (RNC) and Kähler normal coordinates (KNC) give equivalent results?

sources.title: AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the unbounded number of gauge fields obtained by increasing an orbifold order violate a quantum-gravity bound on massless matter? This example requires deciding which dimensions constitute the full spacetime.

sources.title: On global symmetries and Fayet–Iliopoulos terms

evidence.text: Does a genuine FI term force an exact continuous global matter symmetry at every order in four-dimensional N = 1 supergravity? Can supersymmetric operators break that symmetry while preserving FI gauge invariance, a formal rigid limit, and the possibility of an un-Higgsed vector?

sources.title: The Off-shell (3/2, 2) supermultiplets revisited

evidence.text: Classify free massless (3/2,2) off-shell supermultiplets realized by a real axial-vector superfield H, with or without compensators, and distinguish pure linearized supergravity from supergravity accompanied by propagating matter.

sources.title: The Supercurrent in supersymmetric field theories

evidence.text: How can one construct a supercurrent for a general effective N=1 supersymmetric gauge theory, isolate explicit R-symmetry breaking, and identify conditions under which an R-current remains conserved?

sources.title: On the origin of constrained superfields

evidence.text: Can a single organizing constraint remove any selected superfield component, reproduce existing constrained multiplets, and identify operators whose dominant equations of motion generate those constraints?
